Hi Lena,

Thanks again for the discovery earlier today — really helpful to understand where EdgeTech is trying to reduce inference costs and tighten 95th percentile latency for your search ranking path. I attached the estimate and a short TCO model (see filenames below).

Quick summary:
- Estimated monthly token spend (production): ~45M tokens
- Two-tier proposal: Hosted API baseline + Dedicated pool for peak windows (see page 2 for blended unit economics)
- Expected 95p latency improvement vs current infra: ~25–40% depending on batch size

Attachments: Redwood_Pricing_Estimate_EdgeTech_v1.pdf; Redwood_TCO_Model_EdgeTech.xlsx

If it helps, I can run a 15-minute walkthrough of the deck and call out the assumptions that matter for procurement (data residency, audit logs, KMS). Are you available for a short screen share next week? Two windows that work on my side: Tue 8/14 10:00–10:30 PT or Wed 8/15 14:00–14:30 PT.

If timing shifted on your side, no problem — just reply with the best next step (pause / prioritize / connect procurement) and we’ll adjust.

Best,

Diego — sorry for the radio silence, been juggling a couple of things here. Thanks for sending the estimate and the TCO file. A couple of quick clarifying questions from procurement and engineering before we can move forward:

1) Does the estimate include cross-region replication costs (we need EU failover)? If not, can you ballpark the delta?
2) Is there an option to trial Dedicated capacity for a short pilot (30 days) so we can validate latency under load before committing to a monthly commit?
3) Can you confirm the data classification/retention defaults in the Hosted API path (we may need explicit retention settings for certain event types).

Procurement is on copy — if we can get short answers to these (and a 15-min call to go over them), that would help speed internal approval. Would 13:00 PT today work for you?

Thanks,
Lena Parker
Director, Product Ops — EdgeTech Systems

On Thu, Aug 16, 2028 at 1:56 PM Lena Parker <lena.parker@edgetech.com> wrote:
> Diego — sorry for the radio silence, been juggling a couple of things here. Thanks for sending the estimate and the TCO file. A couple of quick clarifying questions from procurement and engineering before we can move forward:
>
> 1) Does the estimate include cross-region replication costs (we need EU failover)? If not, can you ballpark the delta?
> 2) Is there an option to trial Dedicated capacity for a short pilot (30 days) so we can validate latency under load before committing to a monthly commit?
> 3) Can you confirm the data classification/retention defaults in the Hosted API path (we may need explicit retention settings for certain event types).

Thanks for the questions — quick answers below and happy to unpack on the call:

1) Cross-region replication is not in the line-item base estimate — it’s an add-on that covers replicated KV cache and model sync (rough ballpark: +18–22% of the blended unit cost for EU failover; I’ll include a short appendix with a worked example).
2) Yes — we can stand up a 30-day Dedicated pilot with a capped quota and a temporary (non-recurring) discount to compensate setup. Pilot includes monitoring + one enablement session with our solutions engineer.
3) Hosted API default retention is 30 days for request metadata and 0 days for request payloads unless a customer explicitly enables retention for evals/logging. We can supply a SOC2-friendly retention addendum and KMS controls; Marissa (CC’d) can share the compliance checklist.

I can take 13:00 PT today — let me know if you want me to send a calendar invite for 13:00–13:15 PT and include a short agenda: 1) replication delta, 2) pilot mechanics, 3) procurement next steps.

Best,
Diego Fernández
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 (415) 555-0143
